title: Core Player/GM/Product UX
objective: Complete the core Player, GM and product UX seam required before SAA: ordinary account/Campaign entry, campaign selection/resume, Character use, session-facing GM control, shared navigation/status/error/recovery patterns and accessible provider-off product flows, while deferring final Creator/SAA integration to SMB10B.

scope.purpose: Provide the core Player/GM/product experience seam that makes the completed Campaign usable through ordinary product workflows and unlocks SAA without prematurely folding final Creator integration into this tranche.
included: Player Campaign discovery/join/resume and Character-facing primary journeys over sealed Campaign/owner state
GM Campaign/World/Adventure/session-facing primary journeys over sealed owner domains
shared navigation, status, validation, recovery and offline/provider-off behavior for core product use
accessible keyboard/touch/textual equivalents for blocking Player/GM journeys
SMB-09 The Harrowfen Signal as the principal first-party Campaign proof input
existing UI/system/studio projections consumed through sealed contracts rather than reimplemented
scope.completion_gate: Core Player/GM/product UX proof passes across the principal ordinary-user journeys required by the ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH SMB10A golden gate, with no replacement Campaign/runtime authority and no dependency on SAA or SMB10B.

boundaries: SMB-09 is sealed completed_verified and remains the first-party Campaign proof input.
Campaign/World/Adventure/Character and other owner domains retain canonical state and mutation authority.
SMB10A is core Player/GM/product UX only; final Creator/SAA integration belongs to SMB10B after SAA-20.
SAA may not be govern-started until SMB10A completes and all other fresh SAA start gates are reconciled.
Existing projection/studio/runtime families remain sealed capability owners.
No external tester distribution, public release, commerce or paid-provider activation is authorized here.
Blocking core UX must remain accessible, provider-off where supported, optional-AI independent and paid-cloud independent.
next_action: Await the next owner Continue. That command may governed-start only SMB10A — Core Player/GM/Product UX; SAA-01, SMB10B and later SMB work remain unauthorized.
